bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest Bears story remains the fallout from their blockbuster trade for All-Pro defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons, as the Chicago Bears are going all-in on their pursuit of a Super Bowl in 2026 by acquiring All-Pro defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons in a trade with the Titans , with Simmons set to debut as Chicago prepares for Monday Night Football against Seattle. Adding to the storylines ahead of that matchup, the Bears may have a Colston Loveland injury problem brewing as they prepare for the Seahawks game, with one more practice before his game-day status is decided , while Chicago is already down one of its top two tight ends after shutting down veteran Cole Kmet exactly one week ago .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Lions' defense continues to build toward a full strength return as All-Pro safety Kerby Joseph works his way back into practice, though he was not fully participating and sat out Friday's session while being eased back after a long absence. Kerby Joseph has not been a full participant yet at practice, with the medical and coaching staff easing him back into action this week, and Dan Campbell did not express concerns despite Joseph wearing a compression sleeve.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers defeated the Carolina Panthers 27-19 in Thursday Night Football at Lambeau Field, improving to 5-3 and heading into their mini-bye week. The win was highlighted by Christian Watson's dramatic return, who was taken to the hospital via ambulance earlier in the game but came back to make an impact, finishing with 112 receiving yards.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings enter Week 8 as the NFL's only unbeaten team at 6-0, preparing to face the Detroit Lions on the road with running backs Jordan Mason and Aaron Jones expected to share the backfield after Jones avoided an injury designation for his knee. The Minnesota Vikings are the NFL's only unbeaten team thanks to their stingy defense and stellar special teams , while Mason and Aaron Jones will share the backfield against the Lions on Sunday after the latter avoided an injury designation for Week 8 .
